novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement hypothesis: a "late-layer expression gate" where "modulating the gate changes expression without changing what was retrieved," shared across uncertainty, format mismatch, and safety-like triggers. Searches for "late layer factual expression gate decodable knowledge not expressed," "knowing but not saying activation steering LLM," and "uncertainty factuality shared circuits" identify Arditi et al. (2024), Inference-Time Intervention (Li et al., 2023), and SCIURus (2025) as the closest work on low-rank behavioral control, truthfulness steering, and shared uncertainty/factuality circuitry, but none establishes a retrieval-invariant, content-general factual-expression bottleneck. The step is a substantive natural extension and integration of latent-knowledge probing with established behavior-direction steering, rather than an entirely new intervention paradigm; its distinctive common-gate relationship supports standard novelty.
